scale: Each factor is 1 (low/favourable) to 5 (high); score=(expected_impact*confidence*urgency)/(effort*risk). Risk 1 is lowest risk.
rescore_trigger: When baseline_metrics.json, competitor_intel.json, and geo_grid_baseline.json are validated, and monthly thereafter.

levers.action: Validate analytics, conversion definitions, UTM rules, and a repeatable geo-grid baseline before optimization claims.
levers.rationale: Every downstream decision depends on comparable evidence.
levers.gate: Analytics/privacy owner approves collection and retention.
levers.acceptance: All required baseline fields have source, collection time, status, and quality flags; repeat run uses identical grid configuration.

levers.action: Audit and propose accurate GBP category, service, hours, URL, photo, and Q&A updates.
levers.rationale: Completeness and accuracy strengthen discovery and conversion without manipulating ranking.
levers.gate: Business owner verifies every fact and explicitly approves GBP publication.
levers.acceptance: Approved fields match real-world operations; change log and rollback snapshot retained.

levers.action: Publish one evidence-backed Burlington service hub with unique proof, services, FAQs, conversion tracking, and valid schema.
levers.rationale: Creates a relevant local destination; value depends on verified business facts and proof.
levers.gate: Brand, legal, SEO, and production owner approval.
levers.acceptance: No fabricated address/testimonial; indexable canonical page passes schema, accessibility, performance, link, and analytics checks.

levers.action: Pilot a sentiment-neutral, consent-aware review request workflow after genuine completed engagements.
levers.rationale: Authentic feedback can improve trust, but CASL and platform policy make controls essential.
levers.gate: Legal/privacy and channel owner approve lawful basis, copy, suppression, retention, and send.
levers.acceptance: No NPS filtering; one-click unsubscribe where applicable; suppression and consent evidence tested; every send audited.

levers.action: Run a two-post local content pilot and repurpose approved excerpts for Instagram and LinkedIn.
levers.rationale: Tests local demand without committing to an unsupported publishing volume.
levers.gate: Editor verifies sources, rights, claims, and local relevance before publication.
levers.acceptance: Each item has a distinct search intent, cited sources, CTA UTM, owner, review date, and 30-day result.

levers.action: Audit authoritative profiles and correct material NAP inconsistencies individually.
levers.rationale: Accuracy reduces user confusion; broad directory submission is intentionally excluded.
levers.gate: Business owner approves canonical NAP and each account mutation.
levers.acceptance: Before/after capture exists for each approved correction; no low-quality bulk submissions.

levers.action: Qualify five relevant local organizations and send individually reviewed, value-first proposals.
levers.rationale: Earned local relevance and referral potential, with outcomes dependent on partner fit.
levers.gate: Human approves recipient, lawful basis, message, and any sponsorship commitment.
levers.acceptance: Five researched dossiers; no scraped personal addresses or automated follow-up; replies and opt-outs logged.
